title: When the Deadline Turns
author: Tamsin Halloran
blurb: Lena Sterling, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
